title: Power series over a local ring: local, units have unit constant term
statement: Let $A$ be a local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_A$, $d\ge0$, and $A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ the formal power series ring [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series]; write $F(0)=a_0$ for the constant coefficient of $F=\sum_Ea_EX^E$. Then (a) a power series $F$ is a unit of $A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ if and only if $F(0)$ is a unit of $A$; (b) $A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ is a local ring, and its maximal ideal is $\{F: F(0)\in\mathfrak m_A\}$.
